info.name: AutoPhish: Phishing Simulation & Training
info.summary: Connect Nextcloud groups to AutoPhish phishing simulations
info.description:
## Nextcloud phishing simulation with AutoPhish
[AutoPhish](https://autophish.io/) is a phishing simulation and security awareness training platform that helps organizations test how employees respond to simulated phishing emails. Create and manage simulation campaigns in AutoPhish, using recipient lists kept current from your Nextcloud groups.
This integration connects your Nextcloud users to AutoPhish through selected group memberships:
- Map each selected Nextcloud group to its own dedicated AutoPhish target list. - Create a new target list or connect an existing ordinary list. - Keep recipients up to date with scheduled or manual synchronization. - Review synchronization status, the last run and membership counts in Nextcloud administration.
AutoPhish handles campaign creation, email delivery and simulation results. This app synchronizes recipient lists; it does not send simulation emails or launch campaigns. Stale list memberships are removed only after complete reads and verified additions.
### Requirements
An AutoPhish account, a company ID and an API key with `targets:read` and `targets:write` permissions are required. Configure the connection in Nextcloud administration and verify recipient domains in AutoPhish before syncing.
### Data sent outside Nextcloud
Selected members' primary email addresses and, for new recipients, display names (split into first and last names) are sent to the configured AutoPhish HTTPS service. Group membership is represented by membership in the mapped target list. Administrator-chosen list names, the API key and company ID are also sent. Nextcloud user IDs and group IDs remain local; no wider directory export or telemetry is performed.
Administrators must authorize this transfer and verify recipient domains in AutoPhish before syncing. See the [AutoPhish privacy policy](https://autophish.io/privacy/service).
